goal.definition: Verified payouts in one calendar month, minus marketplace and payment fees, refunds and business expenses.

scripture.credit: Scripture quotations are from the World English Bible (WEB), which is in the public domain. Where the WEB uses the name Yahweh, many other translations print "the LORD".

aiDisclosure: This journal was planned, written and laid out with the help of AI tools, then read, edited and approved page by page by a person. Scripture is quoted directly from the World English Bible and was not generated.
careNote: This journal is a companion for prayer and reflection. It is not counseling or medical care. If you are struggling to cope, please talk to a doctor, a licensed counselor or a pastor you trust. If you are in the United States and in crisis, call or text 988 at any time.
